نحبب (form I)
# نَحْبِبْ (naḥbib) /naħ.bib/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of حَبَّ (ḥabba)
# نُحْبَبْ (nuḥbab) /nuħ.bab/: first-person plural non-past passive jussive of حَبَّ (ḥabba) and حُبَّ (ḥubba)
# نَحْبُبْ (naḥbub) /naħ.bub/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of حَبَّ (ḥabba)
# نَحْبَبْ (naḥbab) /naħ.bab/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of حَبَّ (ḥabba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
